useCase: Sim racing drivers want to share lap telemetry achievements: sector times, deltas against PB, apex speeds as shareable cards.
who: Competitive sim racers in iRacing, Assetto Corsa, Le Mans Ultimate communities; platforms like SimTelemetry.site, YouTube channels, competitive leagues.
title: Sim Racing Lap Card

revisions.rejected: Core visual feature (proportional delta bars) promised in brief is missing; template renders only colored text deltas, not bar elements. Acceptance rubric requires visual bars; the stills prove they do not exist.
